children: GREENE COUNTY BANCORP INC reported fiscal 2026 net income of $41M, up from $31.1M a year earlier, on revenue (interest income) of $131.1M versus $117.7M in FY2025; diluted EPS rose to $2.41 from $1.83 as margins and loan balances expanded.
Revenue: $131.1M for FY2026, compared with $117.7M in FY2025; YoY change 11.4%.
Net income: $41.0M for FY2026, compared with $31.1M in FY2025; YoY change 31.7%.
Diluted EPS: $2.41 for FY2026, compared with $1.83 in FY2025.
Net interest income and margin expansion drove core earnings growth, contributing materially to the 31.7% rise in net income.
Net loans grew 7.7%, led by commercial real estate originations that expanded interest-earning assets.
Deposit growth and disciplined pricing reduced funding costs, supported by higher NOW and noninterest-bearing deposits.
Management invested in staffing, IT and branch infrastructure, including a new branch, disaster recovery capabilities and software to support digital initiatives.
Asset quality remained sound with low non-performing assets, a modest ACL build under CECL, and active monitoring of commercial CRE concentrations and liquidity.
